name: World Development Indicators
description: A World Bank compilation of cross-country development indicators assembled from national and international producers and disseminated with indicator-level metadata.

scope.population: Countries, territories, and economy groups represented in the World Bank classification and source systems.
scope.geographic_coverage: More than 200 countries and territories, with indicator-specific availability.
scope.spatial_resolution: Primarily national or economy level; some aggregates and exceptional subnational series exist.
scope.temporal_coverage: 1960-2025 in the catalog snapshot; exact coverage is indicator-specific.

release.update_frequency: Rolling database with documented periodic release notes, including quarterly updates.

limitations: Indicator definitions, primary producers, coverage, and estimation methods differ.
Full comparability across economies and time cannot be assumed.
Group aggregates can approximate unknown totals or averages when data are missing.

verification.notes: Official catalog, user guide, sources and methods, release notes, and API documentation checked. Variable-level coverage and upstream provenance must still be verified per indicator.

evidence.title: World Development Indicators - World Bank Data Catalog
